paragraphs: (Gaddi bo Susi [compare ben Susi in Numbers 13:11].) R' Yudan ben Gadya; Pesikta de-Rav Kahana, supplied locator 25b.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The frozen biblical name reads גדי בו סוסי. Numbers13:11 in the consulted Masoretic text has Gaddi ben Susi; ben is therefore bracketed as the proposed correction. The original Hebrew remains unchanged.

The whole named Miqra according to the Masorah Numbers 13:11 has Gaddi ben Susi. Hyman’s supplied bo is now retained literally beside that comparison; the current historical note remains verbatim and its bracketed-ben proposal is not a canonical Hebrew correction. Yudan’s uncollated pointer remains R', and the supplied Pesikta 25b locator is retained without a fresh printed-pagination claim.
